name: agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene
body:
Reconciliation / provenance (spec-writer, `agent-builder-agents-md` change-set).

SOURCE: make the distributed `agent-builder` own `AGENTS.md` hygiene — a main-write grant on the repo-root `AGENTS.md`; ensure `AGENTS.md` neither contradicts the distributed-agent rules nor duplicates the canonical change-set process (owned solely by the distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt); act non-destructively (preserve all repo-specific content); act only when an `AGENTS.md` exists; and make the rule UNIVERSAL (every apg project — the apg repo's `build-implementer` also touching `AGENTS.md` is a LOCAL arrangement, not a universal rule).

VERIFIED against the branch graph: the sole code surface edited by this change-set resolves — `File {fqn:'opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md', code_type:'docs'}` — so its `implemented-by` edge resolves and NO planned Implementation node is needed. `AGENTS.md` is a scanned `docs` File but is NOT edited here (consumer artifact); `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` is NOT edited here. The existing `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` already enumerates the file's surfaces (a)-(d) and is `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`; the existing `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` and `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` named the agent-builder's main-write surface as `.opencode/agents/**` PLUS `opencode.json`.

DECISION — narrow new component, coverage 1:1. Added `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` whose ONLY `implemented-by` target is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`, so the new requirement's derived solution coverage maps 1:1 to the one edited file. Two components sharing one code target is established practice in this tree (`solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` / `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`). `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` is AMENDED to add the surface (e) for consistency, but the new narrow component is what the coverage check resolves through.

DECISION — main-write accounting. The source phrased the new count as "four paths under carve-out 1". Read consistently, the correct accounting is FOUR main-write paths ACROSS the two carve-outs — `.opencode/agents/**`, the `opencode.json` agent→model map, the repo-root `AGENTS.md`, and the release-agent's artefact set — with carve-out 1 covering THREE of them and the carve-out COUNT staying TWO. This is the reading recorded in the amended `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` and in the new constraint.

Added:
- `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` (feature `agent-builder-agents-md`) — the grant, non-contradiction, non-duplication, non-destructive, only-when-present and universality rules.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` (`attaches-to` the requirement) — the law form: non-destructive merge, only-when-present, navigator-owns-the-process, four-paths/two-carve-outs accounting, universality.
- `domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface` (kind `entity`) — the guide's hygiene contract as a concept, distinct from `agent-scaffold-flow` and `graph-first-navigation`.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene` — the narrow owner, `implemented-by` `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` ONLY.

Amended in place (edge-preserving `apg_node update`):
- `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` — carve-out 1 now names the repo-root `AGENTS.md` as a third path; the count line reads FOUR main-write paths across two carve-outs, carve-out COUNT still TWO.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` — the agent-builder's main-write grants now name `.opencode/agents/**` AND the `opencode.json` agent→model map AND the repo-root `AGENTS.md`; its acceptance is updated to match.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` — surfaces (a) and (c) now include the `AGENTS.md` frontmatter grant, and a new surface (e) states the AGENTS.md hygiene responsibility.

SPINE. `requirements.user.navigator-agent ⊃ requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene —drives→ domain.entity.repo-agent-guide-surface —realised-by→ solution.component.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene —implemented-by→ opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`.

PLAN CONSEQUENCE (for the plan-writer). Satisfy ONLY the NEW requirement `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-agents-md-hygiene`; the single edited file is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. Do NOT declare `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow`, `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`, `requirements.requirement.navigator-staged-flow`, `requirements.requirement.code-writer-worktree-only-writes` or `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git` satisfied: each reaches a component whose `implemented-by` targets (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or tests) this change-set does NOT edit, and `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` derives solution coverage from satisfied requirements' spine.

NON-GOALS. `AGENTS.md`, `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` and the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are NOT edited. `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` is deliberately left as the scaffold→commit→rebase flow owner (its surface enumeration is supplemented, not contradicted, by the amended constraint). The apg repo's own `AGENTS.md` still carries process prose that duplicates the canonical process; refreshing it is the post-RELEASE agent-builder follow-up, never a change-set task.

OPEN QUESTIONS.
1. NAVIGATOR PROMPT: should `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` also state that it dispatches the agent-builder for `AGENTS.md` hygiene (its "Codebase agents" section currently covers only missing/outdated agents)? Deliberately NOT widened into this change-set — the code target stays single-file (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`). Flagged for the coordinator / a future change-set.
2. UNIVERSAL-vs-LOCAL: the apg repo's `build-implementer` also touching `AGENTS.md` is modelled as a local arrangement only; no spec node encodes it. Confirm reviewers agree the universal law reads cleanly without naming `build-implementer`.
3. The `AGENTS.md` guide prose in the apg repo (e.g. its step-7 statement that the agent-builder's sole write surface is `.opencode/agents/**`) is stale relative to the FOUR-path accounting; refreshing it is the post-release follow-up noted above.
